mentions.note: Tarahumara, 25, group leader and spokesman, Leadville 100; from Norogachic; won Leadville 100 in 17 hours 30 minutes, 25 minutes inside course record

photos.c: FINISHED Juan Herrera after the Leadville 100. Completely shattered, nauseous, he looks like a rabbit caught in the headlights.
